title: Composition on disjoint coordinates
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be disjoint finite sets of coordinates, let $T$ be a decision tree over $A$ with labels in $\alpha$, and let $K$ assign to each label in $\alpha$ a decision tree over $B$ with labels in $\beta$. The resulting tree over $A\cup B$ runs $T$ first, then follows the tree assigned by $K$ to the label returned by $T$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite coordinate sets $A$ and $B$ are disjoint
A decision tree on $A$ with labels in $\alpha$
For each $\alpha$-label, a decision tree on $B$ with labels in $\beta$
